Build a stress spec from a fitted mmrm model

Source: R/constructors.R
stress_spec_mmrm.Rd

Takes the data, response, subject, visit, covariance structure, degrees-of-freedom method and variance estimator from an mmrm fit. The treatment variable is the factor that interacts with the visit variable unless given.

Usage

stress_spec_mmrm(
  fit,
  treatment = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  active = NULL,
  contrast_visit = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  weights = "equal",
  label = "pre-specified",
  sas_conventions = TRUE
)

Arguments

fit

An object of class mmrm.

treatment

Name of the treatment column; NULL finds the factor in an interaction with the visit variable.

reference, active, contrast_visit, alpha, weights, label, sas_conventions

As in stress_spec().

Value

A stress_spec.

Examples

fit <- mmrm::mmrm(FEV1 ~ RACE + SEX + FEV1_BL + ARMCD * AVISIT + us(AVISIT | USUBJID),
                  data = mmrm::fev_data)
stress_spec_mmrm(fit, reference = "PBO")
#> <stress_spec> pre-specified
#>   data:       800 rows, 200 subjects, visits VIS1 VIS2 VIS3 VIS4
#>   model:      FEV1 ~ RACE + SEX + FEV1_BL + ARMCD + AVISIT + ARMCD:AVISIT + us(AVISIT | USUBJID)
#>   contrast:   TRT - PBO at VIS4
#>   inference:  Satterthwaite df, Asymptotic vcov, alpha 0.05
